AC: Done when: (1) root cause confirmed (leak vs scan-triggered full-library Node copies) with repro or fix on a fork; (2) SHD can rescan or run for extended uptime without Volumio OOM while MPD plays; (3) deploy path documented for minidsp-shd OEM image; (4) optional upstream issue filed if no existing ticket.

Body.raw:
## Context (2026-08-18 investigation)

Device: miniDSP SHD streamer module (NanoPi Neo3 aarch64, ~986MB RAM, no swap).
Bonjour: _Volumio._tcp instance "miniDSP SHD" -> minidsp-shd.local:3000 (192.168.88.163).
Volumio 3.912, variant minidspshd, build 2026-03-05; updater reports latest.

## Incident

User could not pause while music kept playing. Journal shows:
- 10:02:24 FATAL: JavaScript heap out of memory (Volumio PID 1898, up since Aug 11)
- systemd restarted volumio.service multiple times; MPD separate process kept playing
- Concurrent MPD library update/rescan of NAS/gmk (updatedb: true in state)

## Memory facts (SSH)

- volumio.service: ExecStart=/usr/bin/node /volumio/index.js, NODE_ENV=production only
- Fresh node -p v8.getHeapStatistics(): heap_size_limit ~265MB (~253MB)
- Crash GC line: Scavenge 216.0 (221.3) MB before OOM
- Post-restart main node RSS ~181MB; tag_cache 2.6MB; albumart ~78MB
- /mnt/NAS total files: 101379; user ls count on music collection: 2359 files

## Architecture (volumio3-backend mpd plugin)

- updateDb() -> mpd update (O(1) on Node side for scan itself)
- system-database handler: memoryCache.del cacheAlbumList; listAlbums(); getMyCollectionStats()
- listAlbums(): search album "" -> split lines -> build JS album objects -> cacheAlbumList ttl 0
- getMyCollectionStats(): count group artist + list album group albumartist (full responses)
- getTracklist(): listallinfo (full library dump)
- Startup (5s): listAlbums + getMyCollectionStats

## GitHub scan

No open volumio3-backend issue for bounded/constant-RAM library scanning.
Related closed/old: Volumio2#599 (Node OOM), #890 (scan crash), #1919 (large library);
volumio-mpd#1 open (MPD SEGV on rescan).

## Fork / deploy sketch (speculative)

- Volumio backend: fork volumio3-backend, volumio pull -b <branch> -r <fork> or rsync /volumio, volumio vrestart; OTA wipes overlay
- MPD: cross-compile volumio-mpd fork, replace /usr/bin/mpd; do not flash generic NanoPi image (lose OEM I2S/volume)
- Dirac/DSP firmware on separate chip; unaffected

## Mitigations (interim)

- Avoid library rescan during playback; schedule off-hours
- Periodic volumio vrestart or weekly reboot
- Pin DHCP 192.168.88.163 if mDNS flaky
- Consider .mpdignore for problematic NAS paths/formats

## Open questions

- Is 216MB mostly leak over 7 days or scan-triggered listAlbums spike?
- Should fix target Node pagination, MPD upstream, or both?
- Can NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size help without masking leak?

LongSummary.raw: Investigate and eventually fix MiniDSP SHD (NanoPi Neo3, Volumio 3.912 minidspshd) becoming unresponsive to pause/volume while MPD keeps playing. Session 2026-08-18: Volumio Node (PID 1898, 7-day uptime) hit JavaScript heap OOM at ~216MB against a ~253MB V8 limit (Node 14.21.3, no max-old-space-size in volumio.service). MPD continued playback independently. Concurrent NAS library rescan (updatedb true) was running; mpd.log showed mass update of NAS/gmk from 09:58. Device: Bonjour miniDSP SHD, minidsp-shd.local, 192.168.88.163:3000. User-counted music tree ~2359 files; full /mnt/NAS mount ~101379 files; MPD tag_cache only 2.6MB so indexed library is small. Architecture waste: updateDb is thin (mpd update) but ControllerMpd on system-database runs listAlbums (search album empty string, full split/parse, cacheAlbumList ttl 0) and getMyCollectionStats (count group artist, list album). getTracklist uses listallinfo. No open volumio3-backend GitHub issue for bounded-memory scanning. Fork/deploy: volumio pull or rsync /volumio; MPD binary cross-compile; OTA overwrites overlays. Software reported up to date via built-in updater.
